label: Near-real-time cached threat activity from public feeds
cache_note: This is a near-real-time cached snapshot built by the fetch job. It is not a live attack stream.
sample_note: The indicator table keeps the newest rows from each feed, up to a cap. Country totals, malware-family totals, ASN totals, and the unfiltered 24 hour chart use the full parse.

feeds.name: Spamhaus DROP and EDROP
feeds.licence: Use only under the Spamhaus DROP terms. This cache attributes Spamhaus and does not resell the lists.
feeds.role_note: Listed networks. Country is the DB-IP country of the network address, not a victim country. The file has one last-modified time, not a timestamp per network, so these rows are left out of the 24 hour chart.

feeds.name: SANS ISC DShield
feeds.licence: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Attribute SANS Technology Institute, Internet Storm Center. Do not resell.
feeds.role_note: Source addresses reported to DShield sensors, grouped by the country of the source. The target number in the API is a destination-address count, not a target country. SANS describes the country table as about the last 30 days and does not stamp each row. SANS ISC InfoCon at fetch time: green.

feeds.name: abuse.ch SSLBL
feeds.licence: Free to use with attribution to abuse.ch. See the project terms.
feeds.role_note: IP addresses associated with malicious SSL certificates. A mapped country is the DB-IP country of the address, not a victim. The publisher marked this list deprecated in January 2025; an empty parse is reported honestly.

feeds.name: Spamhaus ASN-DROP
feeds.licence: Use only under the Spamhaus DROP terms. This cache attributes Spamhaus and does not resell the lists.
feeds.role_note: Autonomous systems listed by Spamhaus ASN-DROP. These are network listings, not attack paths, and are not drawn as globe arcs.

feeds.name: OpenPhish community feed
feeds.licence: Free community phishing feed. Attribute OpenPhish. See the project site.
feeds.role_note: Phishing URLs. A mapped country is the DB-IP country of an IP literal in the URL, not a victim. The file has no per-row timestamp, so these rows are left out of the 24 hour chart.

feeds.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
feeds.licence: US government catalog. Public domain. Not a geographic attack feed.
feeds.role_note: Vulnerabilities CISA lists as known to be exploited. They are not placed on the globe.

kev.name: Google Chromium Use-After-Free Vulnerability
kev.summary: Google Chromium contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XML component that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code inside the sandbox via a specially crafted webpage. This vulnerability could affect multiple web browsers that utilize Chromium, including, but not limited to, Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Opera.

kev.name: GPUStack Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev.summary: GPUStack contains an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow unauthenticated administrative access, including user and model changes, persistent administrator API-key creation, disclosure of worker and cloud-provider secrets, and code execution through POST /v2/inference-backends/from-yaml.

kev.name: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
kev.summary: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.

kev.name: SignalWire FreeSwitch Code Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: SignalWire FreeSwitch contains a code injection vulnerability that permits configuration and credential disclosure, arbitrary call control, and command execution.

kev.name: IBM Aspera Faspex Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
kev.summary: IBM Aspera Faspex contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to craft a specific message to bypass authorization, causing privilege escalations.

kev.name: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Use of Single-factor Authentication Vulnerability
kev.summary: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN contains a use of single-factor authentication vulnerability that may allow a user with valid credentials for an alternate authentication method to bypass SAML authentication controls. Successful exploitation may also bypass SAML-enforced multi-factor authentication (MFA).

kev.name: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability
kev.summary: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.

kev.name: WordPress WordPress Core Time-of-check Time-of-use (TOCTOU) Race Condition Vulnerability
kev.summary: WordPress WordPress Core contains a time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute code on the server during the upgrade window. This is due to predictable, web-accessible staging paths used during full-package core upgrades.

kev.name: Ivanti Connect Secure Generation of Predictable Numbers or Identifiers Vulnerability
kev.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a generation of predictable numbers or identifiers vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload files with attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-111357.

kev.name: Ivanti Connect Secure Missing Authentication for Critical Function Vulnerability
kev.summary: Ivanti Connect Secure contains a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability that could allow a local authenticated attacker to escalate their privileges. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-104935 and CVE-2026-118527.

kev.name: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition Integer Overflow or Wraparound Vulnerability
kev.summary: GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition contain a integer overflow or wraparound vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server via a specially crafted regular expression in a CI/CD configuration, due to insufficient regular expression validation.

kev.summary: Cisco Secure Firewall ASA Software and Cisco Secure FTD Software contains an unchecked return value to NULL pointer dereference vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to cause the device to reload unexpectedly, resulting in a denial of service (DoS) condition.

kev.name: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
kev.summary: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

kev.name: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
kev.summary: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. kev.name: Adobe Commerce and Magento Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type Vulnerability
kev.summary: Adobe Commerce and Magento contain an unrestricted upload of file with dangerous type vulnerability that could result in arbitrary code execution in the context of the current user, potentially gaining elevated access or control over the victim's account or session.

kev.name: Google Brotli Unchecked Return Value Vulnerability
kev.summary: Google Brotli contains an unchecked return value vulnerability that allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.

kev.name: PHP Memory Corruption Vulnerability
kev.summary: PHP contains an out-of-memory corruption vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev.name: PHP Stale Internal Request-State Vulnerability
kev.summary: PHP contains a stale internal request-state vulnerability that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution.

kev.name: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator SQL Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator on-prem contains a SQL injection vulnerability that may allow a remote attacker to access privileged internal functionality and impact the VCO host. Successful exploitation may compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the orchestrator and data managed by the orchestrator.

kev.name: Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: Collabora Collabora Online – Built-in CODE Server when used within the NextCloud platform contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows for remote code execution when the CODE server isn't running.

kev.name: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition OS Command Injection Vulnerability
kev.summary: EG Secure Solutions SiteGuard Server Edition contains an OS command injection vulnerability which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary OS commands with root or SYSTEM privileges on the system running the affected product.

kev.name: Plex Media Server External Control of File Name or Path Vulnerability
kev.summary: Plex Media Server contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability which can allow an admin user to write arbitrary files that may be executed on load. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96655.

kev.name: Plex Media Server Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) Vulnerability
kev.summary: Plex Media Server contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability that could allow an authenticated user to request arbitrary internal or external addresses via the '/video/:/transcode/universal' path parameter. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-96652, CVE-2026-96654, and CVE-2026-96656.
